title.en: A year of training by June
title.es: Para junio llevaré un año entrenando

es: Formar will have been + -ing para medir la duración de una actividad hasta un punto futuro y contrastarla con will have + participio.

teaching.en: By June, I will have been training for the marathon for a whole year.
teaching.es: Para junio llevaré un año entero entrenando para el maratón.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have been + -ing + for: cuánto tiempo llevará la actividad en ese punto futuro.
segments: By June, I will have been training
for the marathon for a whole year.
teaching.audioText: By June, I will have been training for the marathon for a whole year.

teaching.en: By the end of the month, Ana will have been saving money for six months.
teaching.es: Para finales de mes, Ana llevará seis meses ahorrando dinero.
teaching.explanationEs: By the end of + momento futuro fija el punto desde el que se mide la duración.
segments: By the end of the month, Ana will
have been saving money for six months.
teaching.audioText: By the end of the month, Ana will have been saving money for six months.

teaching.en: Next week, Tom and Mia will have been married for ten years, so it will be their anniversary.
teaching.es: La semana que viene, Tom y Mia llevarán diez años casados: será su aniversario.
teaching.explanationEs: Con estados (married) no se usa -ing: will have been + participio o adjetivo.
segments: Next week, Tom and Mia will have been married
for ten years, so it will be their anniversary.
teaching.audioText: Next week, Tom and Mia will have been married for ten years, so it will be their anniversary.

teaching.en: By then, she will have run one marathon, but she will have been training for two years.
teaching.es: Para entonces habrá corrido un maratón, pero llevará dos años entrenando.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have run cuenta un resultado; will have been training mide la duración.
segments: By then, she will have run one marathon, but
she will have been training for two years.
teaching.audioText: By then, she will have run one marathon, but she will have been training for two years.

teaching.en: How long will you have been saving by the end of the year?
teaching.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevarás ahorrando para finales de año?
teaching.explanationEs: Pregunta: How long + will + sujeto + have been + -ing.
segments: How long will you have been saving
by the end of the year?
teaching.audioText: How long will you have been saving by the end of the year?

prompt.es: Completa: «Para mayo, Ana llevará seis meses ahorrando.»

feedback.es: Will have been + -ing forma la duración: entre have y saving falta been.

hint.es: Después de will have va la palabra que precede al verbo en -ing.

origin.text: By May, Ana will have ___ saving for six months.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase mide cuánto tiempo llevará ocurriendo la actividad?

choices.text: By May, Sara will have read ten books.
By May, Sara will read ten books.
By May, Sara will have been reading for ten hours.

feedback.es: Will have been reading + for ten hours mide duración; will have read cuenta libros terminados.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta: «Para el lunes llevaremos diez años casados.»

choices.text: By Monday we will have been married for ten years.
By Monday we will have been being married for ten years.
By Monday we will be married for ten years.

feedback.es: Married es un estado: se dice will have been married, sin -ing; will be no marca el tiempo acumulado.

hint.es: Estar casado es un estado, no una actividad en curso.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases: resultado o duración.

answer.text: will have written | will have been studying | will have run
accepted: will have written | will have been studying | will have run

feedback.es: Twelve pages y two marathons son resultados (will have + participio); for a week mide duración (will have been + -ing; will have studied también se admite).

sentences: By Friday, Leo ___ (study) for the exam for a week.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para julio, Tom llevará dos años nadando.»

answer.text: By July Tom will have been swimming for two years

feedback.es: By July fija el punto futuro y will have been swimming + for two years mide la duración.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿cuánto tiempo llevará aprendiendo inglés Carlos?

feedback.es: Three years son treinta y seis meses: la duración que Carlos llevará aprendiendo en primavera.

origin.audio: By next spring, Carlos will have been learning English for three years.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para diciembre, Tom llevará un año nadando en el equipo del colegio.»

feedback.es: For a year pide una actividad con duración: will have been swimming.

origin.text: By December, Tom ___ for the school team for a year.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase habla de algo terminado y no de la duración?

choices.text: By Monday, Tom will have been reading the book for a week.
By Monday, Tom will be reading the book for a week.
By Monday, Tom will have finished the book.

feedback.es: Will have finished presenta el libro acabado; las otras dos miden el tiempo leyendo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué tiempo de amistad cumplirán el mes que viene.

choices.text: They will have known each other for ten years.
They will have met ten new friends.
They will have lived together for a year.

feedback.es: Friends for ten years significa que se conocerán desde hace diez años; es un estado, sin -ing.

origin.audio: Next month, Leo and Sara will have been friends for ten years.

prompt.es: Escribe en inglés tu meta: dentro de un año llevarás dos años aprendiendo inglés.

answer.text: By next year I will have been learning English for two years.
accepted: By next year I will have been learning English for two years.
In a year I will have been learning English for two years.
By this time next year I will have been learning English for two years.
A year from now I will have been learning English for two years.

feedback.es: La duración hasta un punto futuro se dice con will have been learning + for two years.

origin.text: Meta: dentro de un año llevarás dos años aprendiendo inglés.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para septiembre, Tom llevará un año trabajando aquí.»

answer.text: By September Tom will have been working here for a year

feedback.es: By September abre el punto futuro y will have been working + for a year mide la duración.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta: «Para abril habré tenido el coche dos años.»

choices.text: By April I will have been having the car for two years.
By April I will have had the car for two years.
By April I will be having the car for two years.

feedback.es: Have, en el sentido de poseer, es un verbo de estado: will have had, sin -ing.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Cuánto tiempo llevarás ahorrando cuando compres la bici?»

feedback.es: La pregunta es How long + will + sujeto + have been + -ing.

origin.text: How long will you ___ been saving when you buy the bike?
